findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When multiple tenants share the database, `loadDocument` now queries solely by `documentId`. A caller that knows or guesses another tenant’s ID can therefore retrieve that tenant’s document. Keep `ctx.tenantId` in the lookup predicate to enforce tenant isolation.

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
The query no longer includes `ctx.tenantId`. If document IDs are guessable or reused across tenants, a caller can retrieve another tenant’s document. Direct callers using the previous three-argument API also either fail TypeScript compilation or query using the tenant ID as the document ID.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Restore the exported cache module
findings.body:
Deleting `src/cache.ts` removes the exported `readCached` API without a replacement. Existing consumers importing this module now fail compilation/module resolution.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body:
In a shared multi-tenant database, an authenticated user who knows or guesses another tenant’s `documentId` can retrieve that tenant’s document because `ctx.tenantId` is no longer included in the query.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
